collection.description: A villager agrees to become the primary caregiver of a child who needs a home.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1) agrees to become the primary caregiver of a child who needs a home. As he prepares a sleeping mat, he realizes that love alone will not organize tomorrow's meals.

choices.label: Let the Child Choose a Comfort Item

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They help arrange meals and childcare for his first week.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Everyone offers advice at once, and he has to organize it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: He creates a welcoming space with small handmade toys.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: He forgets a basic supply and rushes to borrow it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child picks a familiar blanket and relaxes a little.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child chooses nothing yet; he leaves the offer open.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They begin learning each other's habits without pressure.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The child misses their old routine, and he listens patiently.
